statement: The potential −J has pressure zero and Liouville volume is an equilibrium state for it. If hmL (ϕ1) = htop(ϕ1) = h, there is a Hölder function F with flow derivative satisfying J = h + XF. (2.2) The function F is smooth on weak unstable plaques, with uniform bounds at each finite leaf order. There are continuous horizontal m-forms u, w, with u annihilating Eu and w annihilating Es, such that ϕ∗ t u = e−ht u, ϕ∗ t w = eht w, u ∧ w = c∗(dα)m , c∗ ̸= 0. (2.3) The form u has smooth uniformly bounded finite jets on weak unstable plaques, and w has the analogous property on weak stable plaques. These leaf jets vary continuously in uniform plaque charts.
